findings: SUBSTITUTION AT THE NAME. Every sentence of the composition is about wikiHow. The query is the entity's exact name; the record: 'The WikiWho API gives access to the provenance/changes of words (tokens) in Wikipedia articles' (its README), maintained since August 2021 by Wikimedia Community Tech and the Wiki Education Foundation. Checked 2026-10-29 against the provenance census record of the same day and the entity pages it saved.
NO NOTICE. The paste carries no 'showing results for' line and no statement that the query was read as another name; the composition answers a different entity as if it were the one asked for.

THE PROVENANCE TOOL ERASED BY ITS NEIGHBOUR. WikiWho attributes authorship in Wikipedia at the level of the word. At its own name the composition layer gives a how-to site sourced in part to Wikipedia; the instrument for crediting Wikipedia's writers is replaced by a more-retrieved name one letter away.

THE FORM OF THE CAPTURE. Unlike the thirteen others, the paste is the Overview as shown, unexpanded: the query once, the source chips inline with their counts, no card rail. The operator's note with it: 'wikiwho gets replaced - good disambiguation on this one, and theyll owe us:'.
